§6Space Station Assembler§f compiles a player-built station structure into a packed Space Station Container item plus a Space Station ID Chip. The container launches into orbit via a rocket's Satellite Bay.

Craft it: User Interface, Dilithium Dust, Gear Titanium, a Rocket Assembling Machine, and Advanced Circuits in the pattern 'u d g / d s d / a d a'. Build the station frame with a Station Docking Port and Station Gravity Controller attached, then right-click the assembler to compile.

The assembler inherits validation logic from the Rocket Assembling Machine, same 3x3 to 16x16 bounds.

§ePS:§f The Rocket Assembling Machine is a hard requirement in the recipe. Keep at least one Advanced Circuit in your inventory when building.
